{{short description|American cryptographer and mathematician}}
'''Christopher Hall''' is an American [[cryptographer]] and [[mathematician]], specializing in [[arithmetic geometry]]. He is one of the creators of the cryptosystem [[Twofish]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.schneier.com/twofish.html|title=Twofish|last=Schneier|first=Bruce|accessdate=23 January 2010}}</ref> He obtained a [[Bachelor of Science|BS]] from the [[University of Colorado-Boulder]] Department of Computer Science and a [[Doctor of Philosophy|PhD]] in Mathematics from [[Princeton University]] in 2003, under [[Nick Katz]].<ref>{{mathgenealogy|name=Chris Hall|id=71612}}.</ref>

He is an associate professor of mathematics at the [[University of Western Ontario]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.uwo.ca/math/faculty/index.html|title=Faculty|publisher=University of Western Ontario Mathematics Department|accessdate=2020-12-09}}</ref>
